title: PLANNING AND LAND USE MANAGEMENT COMMITTEE REPORT , MITIGATED NEGATIVE DECLARATION, NO. ENV-2025-5195-MND, MITIGATION MEASURES, AND MITIGATION MONITORING…
text:
[Council File 26-1289-S1; CD 10]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
PLANNING AND LAND USE MANAGEMENT COMMITTEE REPORT , MITIGATED NEGATIVE DECLARATION, NO. ENV-2025-5195-MND, MITIGATION MEASURES, AND MITIGATION MONITORING PROGRAM, AND RELATED CALIFORNIA ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY ACT (CEQA) FINDINGS relative to a Class 2 Conditional Use and Project Review appeals for the properties located at 4802 – 4828 West San Vicente Boulevard.
Recommendation(s) for Council action:
1. FIND, pursuant to Sections 21082.1(c)(3) and 21081.6 of the California Public Resources Code and CEQA Guidelines Section 15074(b), after consideration of the whole of the administrative record, including the Mitigated Negative Declaration, No. ENV-2025-5195-MND, and all comments received, with the imposition of mitigation measures, there is no substantial evidence that the Project will have a significant effect on the environment; FIND the Mitigated Negative Declaration reflects the independent judgment and analysis of the City; FIND the mitigation measures have been made enforceable conditions on the Project; and ADOPT the Mitigated Negative Declaration and the Mitigation Monitoring Program prepared for the Mitigated Negative Declaration.
2. ADOPT the FINDINGS of the Los Angeles City Planning Commission (LACPC) as the Findings of Council.
3. RESOLVE TO DENY THE APPEALS filed by: 1) Barbara Calloway; 2) Curtis Clark; 3) Longwood Reynolds Trust, by Edward J. Campbell, Trustee; 4) Eugene Jones, James Draffen, and Jorge Rafael; and 5) Behnaz Gabay, Avi Gabay, and Daniel Gabay, and THEREBY SUSTAIN the LACPC’s determination in: 1) Approving, pursuant to Los Angeles Municipal Code (LAMC) Chapter 1A Section 13B.2.2, a Class 2 Conditional Use to permit storage uses within 500 feet of a R Zone; and 2) Approving, pursuant to LAMC Chapter 1A Section 13B.2.4, a Project Review for a development project which creates, or results in, an increase of 50,000 gross square feet or more of non-residential floor area; for the demolition and removal of the existing one-story warehouse building and two surface parking lots; for the construction, use, and maintenance of a seven-story self-storage facility for household goods encompassing a floor area of 161,645 square feet, the self-storage facility would feature storage units across each floor level, a 954- square-foot office area, a 608-square-foot lobby, a 376-square-foot community room/multi-purpose room, five vehicular parking spaces, 36 bicycle parking spaces, and two loading spaces and would operate between 7:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m., daily; for the properties located at 4802 – 4828 West San Vicente Boulevard, subject to modified Conditions of Approval, as further modified by the Committee to include the voluntary condition provided by the applicant, attached to the Council file.
4. ADOPT technical modifications of Conditions, Findings, and Architectural Plans, as recommended by the Department of City Planning (DCP) report dated October 22, 2026, attached to the Council file.
Applicant: David Kelly, Westport Properties Inc.
Representative: Dana Sayles, Three6ixty Case No. CPC-2025-5194-HD-CU2-PR-ZC-1A
Environmental No. ENV-2025-5195-MND
Related Case No. CPC-2025-5194-HD-CU2-PR-ZC
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The LACPC reports that there is no General Fund impact as administrative costs are recovered through fees.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
TIME LIMIT FILE - NOVEMBER 7, 2026 LAST DAY FOR COUNCIL ACTION - NOVEMBER 6, 2026
summary: Five appeals challenge the approval of a seven-story, 161,645 sq ft self-storage facility that would replace a warehouse and parking lots at 4802–4828 West San Vicente Boulevard. The council decides whether to uphold or overturn the Planning Commission's approval.
